title: Neural View
headline:
Intelligence,
in motion.
intro: An abstract journey through observation, judgment, and independently verified outcomes.
selectAgent:
Select a node.
Follow its story.
selectHint: Choose an agent in the scene or the list to explore its capabilities.
notCalls: Every small node is a real Python definition. Links are static call references, not observed invocations. Activity is simulated.
illustration: Narrative context, not a call edge
help: Drag to orbit. Scroll to zoom. Space to pause. C for cinema. Esc to exit.
webglError: The 3D view is unavailable. Enable WebGL 2 or try a supported browser. The scenario and agent details remain available.
contextLost: The graphics context was lost. Reload to restore the 3D view. Playback has paused.
fullscreenError: Fullscreen is unavailable in this browser. Cinema mode still works.
staticDefinition: Source-backed definition. Runtime invocation is not observed.
declarationOnly: Declared subscriptions. Concurrent delivery is illustrated, not measured.
argRateNote: Inventory worker -> ARG -> collected signals -> Huginn / Heimdall. Demo traffic: 3 requests per active display second, even at 2x. Not a live polling schedule.
subscriptionScope: Canonical agent subscriptions. Optional worker commands and non-agent consumers are outside this view.
tourHint: Automatic overview, broadcast, Python function, and Azure camera tour.
tourReduced: Turn off Reduce motion to use the automatic camera tour.
ontologyIntro: The complete FDAI ontology map, connected to actual instances collected in the local database.
ontologyProvenance: Complete ontology map + local database instances. Read-only.
ontologySource: STORED CATALOG MAP / ACTUAL LOCAL DATABASE INSTANCES
ontologyDisclaimer: Authored demo, not live state. Reads grant no authority; only observed evidence updates current state.
notYetKnown: This instance was not yet known at the selected time.
dispatchNotObserved: Intent and dispatch do not change the observed state.
snapshotCoverage: Snapshot evidence only. Unobserved intermediate transitions remain unknown.
recordedMemory: Read-only, browser memory only. No Azure queries or data exports. Agents are not part of this relationship layout.
recordsFailed: The read failed or the connection expired. Auto-refresh stopped; any visible graph is the last successful read. Reconnect or refresh.
popupBlocked: Allow the Console connection window, then connect again.
connectHelp: Connect using the existing signed-in Console. Credentials stay in Console; only bounded ontology records are shared with this local view.
directoryPartial: Directory is bounded to 200 resources. Search to narrow the source scope.
selectRecordedNode: Select a resource to inspect its relationships.
noRecordedGraph: No recorded graph loaded. Connect Console to read actual instances; no sample data is substituted.
sampledHistoryScope: Only changes between successfully read observed facts in this connection are shown. Earlier history and intermediate changes are unknown. Audit execution states are not resource states.
snapshotDisclosure: Uses the existing ontology instance specimen. Its source is synthetic, not provider-observed data. No Console, API, or Azure connection.
snapshotFailed: The local snapshot could not be loaded. Reload it to retry; no alternate data is substituted.
specimenCoverage: Complete for the included specimen only; no live estate coverage is claimed.
notYetInHistory: No state at this replay time
snapshotStateMeaning: This is the specimen's display state, not a verified operational, provisioning, or availability fact. Topology is a fixed snapshot.
dbPrivacy: Read-only local PostgreSQL snapshot. Original instance names, identifiers, conversation bodies and secrets are not exported. Declarations and instances are distinct layers.
databaseReadFailed: The local database export is unavailable. Check the existing local DB and runtime environment; no mock data is substituted.
currentTopology: Current captured topology / not a historical graph
databaseReadHint: The complete stored ontology map and its collected instances appear here after the local read completes.
storedStateLimit: A stored property is not automatically a verified health fact. Source lane and available timestamps remain separate; missing metadata stays unknown.
detailRelationLimit: First 80 relationships shown in this panel. All matching links remain in the graph; use type and relationship filters to narrow the view.
historyCoverageLimit: These are retained database transitions. Coverage of intermediate changes is not assumed. Playback keeps the current topology fixed; only non-synthetic, conflict-free observed transitions color the replay.
detailHistoryLimit: Latest 40 matching records shown. All exported transitions remain available during time-window replay.
catalogCoveragePartial: The stored catalog reports incomplete coverage.
unresolvedDbLinks: stored links have endpoints outside the current graph.
